Two shy parents and a new baby. Will the child be shy too?

Kevin Trudeau says a child of two very shy parents is programmed to be shy.

Now flip it. Both parents are Broadway comedians who love to be the center of the party. Kevin says the child comes out of the womb asking for a top hat and a cane.

His point is that a lot of who we are is already in the DNA before we choose anything.

Which trait did you get from your parents without ever deciding to?
